title: Dev 20/ Crazy calculation "loop" on main UI with strange graphics
body:
From time to time (didn't find what triggers it), there is a _recalculation new data_ that starts over and over for a long time with strange graphs in the middle of the calculations.

Eventually it stops recalculating and the graph goes back to normal. So, not a major bug but seems strange.

![Screenshot_20220130-085436_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/151692668-2878504f-83c4-4a28-96fe-ab997efedaa5.jpg)

For the logs, look at around 8h54
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1643529458396.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7965566/AndroidAPS_LOG_1643529458396.log.zip)

comments.body: can you paste screenshot of Treatments Temp basals?

Have a nice Sunday, greetings Thomas

Seeing this also when changing scale. But it takes only a few seconds (up to 10?) before it settles down.
